Winter Wonderland

A tiny globe to wander

Prototype tuning

Temporary creative controls — these will not ship in the final experience.

Explore

The explorer always faces forward. Use A / D or ← / → to steer the planet beneath them, then hold W or ↑ to travel straight ahead (or S / ↓ to back up). They gently slide around obstacles. Scroll to zoom; find the bell and press E.

Press E to ring the village bell
